title: The retired /__tracy/build door answers Tracy's 404 for GET and POST and never reaches the customer's copy
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at a PostgreSQL the suite may create schemas in: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/bar.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for the test named in expect.
expect: '/__tracy/build is retired' is ok: GET and POST http://build1.tracy.test/__tracy/build both answer 404 with Tracy's page (no 'built' in the body) and the site proxy is never called (pre-fix: GET answered 200 {"built":null}).
evidence: E2E 04/10/2026 J15.2: GET https://e2ef-wp.tracy.site/__tracy/build answered {"built":null}; 11/10 also e2e1085b and ja-restaurant-joomla. site_build on dev held 0 rows: nothing writes a manifest.
fence: No route answers /__tracy/build; every unknown /__tracy/ path is Tracy's own 404 page, never forwarded to the site.
